dataset.split_design: canonical shuffle = numpy RandomState(val_seed) permutation of the raw train split; val = first val_size canonical ids (identical across runs); train pool = next pool_cap canonical ids (fixed composition), order shuffled per-run by RandomState(data_seed); DataLoader epoch reshuffle uses torch.Generator(data_seed)

lr_schedule: linear warmup 100 steps + cosine to floor 0.1 (pilot train_task_fingerprint.py convention)
loss: LM loss ONLY (no Steersman / contrastive / spectral)
label_convention: labels = input_ids.clone() over the full padded sequence (pilot convention, kept for regime comparability)
scale_note: pilot bank was Qwen2.5-7B; this bank is 1.5B/1B per the locked experiment card — recorded scale change
